Cone Of Cold (Bloodline Boreal6 Evoc): 60' cone inflicts 15d6 HP cold (save Reflex half)
Control Winds (Blizzard Sorcerer5 Tran): R800' Changes the wind direction and speed by 6 levels in a 800'x40' cylinder for 200 min (save Fortitude each rd negates wind effects on a creature for 1 rd)
Elemental Aura (Bloodline Boreal3 Evoc): Inflicts 2d6 HP of a chosen energy type plus energy-specific effects (save Reflex half HP only) on adjacent creatures for 20 rd; acid inflicts sickened and 1 HP acid each rd for 6 rd, cold inflicts fatigued, electricity inflicts staggered for 1 rd, and fire catches creatures on fire
Enlarge Person (Bloodline Boreal1 Tran): R75' Target humanoid doubles in size (save Fortitude negates), gaining +2 Strength and suffering -2 Dexterity, -1 attacks, and a -1 size penalty to Armor Class, for 20 min
Fire Shield (Snow Shroud4 Evoc): Envelopes self in cold or hot flames that inflict 1d6+15 HP cold or fire on melee attackers (SR may negate) and either reduce heat or cold damage taken by half or negate it entirely with a successful allowed Reflex save, for 20 rd
Giant Form I (Bloodline Boreal7 Tran): Self becomes a Large giant for 20 min, gaining +6 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, a +4 natural bonus to Armor Class, Low-Light vision, and, depending on the form taken, 60' Darkvision, a rend attack that inflicts 2d6 HP, regeneration 5, rock catching, and 60' rock throwing that inflicts 2d6 HP
Meteor Swarm (Bloodline Boreal9 Evoc): R1200' Ranged touch attack with each of 4 2'-diameter spheres inflicts 2d6 HP bludgeoning, plus 6d6 HP fire in a 40' radius (save Reflex half; creatures hit by a meteor have a -4 penalty)
Polar Ray (Bloodline Boreal8 Evoc): R300' Ranged touch attack inflicts 20d6 HP and drains 1d4 points of Dexterity
Rage (Bloodline Boreal3 Ench): R300' Gives 6 willing targets in a 15' radius +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, +1 Will, and -2 Armor Class for concentration + 20 rd
Sleet Storm (Blizzard Sorcerer3 Conj): R1200' 40' radius, 20' high cylinder blocks sight, extinguishes small fires, and requires a DC 10 Acrobatics check to move at half Speed (failure by 5 or more causes a fall) for 20 rd
Spider Climb (Icewalker2 Tran): Gives touched a 20' climb Speed, a +8 bonus to Climb checks, and the ability to climb walls and ceilings (save Will negates) for 200 min; the target also retains its Dexterity bonus to Armor Class while climbing
Transformation (Bloodline Boreal6 Tran): Gives self +4 Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, a +4 natural armor bonus, +5 Fortitude, simple and martial weapon proficiency, and a +20 BAB, but prevents the casting of spells, for 20 rd
Wall Of Ice (Bloodline Boreal4 Evoc): R300' Creates a 200 square foot wall or a 23' radius hemisphere of 20"-thick ice for 20 min (save Reflex by adjacent creatures causes the spell to fail); each 10' section has 60 hit points, and passing through a broken section of the wall inflicts 1d6+20 HP cold
